'''''Princess of the Rebellion''''' is a forthcoming young adult novel focusing on [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]] that takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Episode IV: A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']], and will be published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press|Random House/Star Wars]] on [[May 4]], [[2027]], as part of the 50th anniversary of ''A New Hope''. Written by [[Claudia Gray]], the book will focus on Leia in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin]] as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuates]] their [[Great Temple|base]] on [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Penguin" />
